props.stem: A short, realistic situation told in two sentences. A colleague comes to you with a problem you have seen before. **What do you do first?**

options.text: Offer the solution that worked for you last time
options.feedback: Tempting, and quick. Yet it skips what makes this case different: ask first.

options.text: Ask an open question to understand their situation
options.feedback: Yes. An open question shows you listen, and often brings the answer forward.

options.text: Suggest they write to the team that handles it
options.feedback: It may come later, once you know what they need. For now it closes the door.
